metadata.description: Canvas LMS course-building tools for instructors (Claude Code plugins).

plugins.name: notion-to-canvas
plugins.description: Notion to Canvas course builder + generate-and-place content. Content only; never reads student data.

plugins.name: canvas-pii-guard
plugins.description: Local PII-prevention hooks: blocks Canvas student-data API calls and local-cache reads before they run, so student data is never fetched or transmitted. Install on instructor machines alongside notion-to-canvas.
